title: ExternalCorrectionRequest
description: Data bundle for one submission (task + writer) that an external correction provider receives from the assessment system. Produced by scripts/export_item.py from GET /provider/data and GET /provider/item.

ass_id.description: Assessment id in the assessment service

context_id.description: Context id (ILIAS ref_id) of the assessment object

pseudonym.description: Pseudonymized writer name; no real names are exported

provider.description: Identity of the provider's corrector record. All returned suggestions are stored under this corrector.

position.description: Grading position of the provider's assignment (0 = first)

solution.description: Model solution / grading hints, HTML, may be empty

text.description: The writer's submission as HTML. Word positions for comments refer to the words of this text in document order (1-based, as counted by the corrector app).

pdf_available.description: True if the submission exists as PDF (pdf_version); pages are then image based and comment positions refer to marks on pages instead of word positions

criteria.description: Rating criteria the provider may assign points to. Only criteria of the provider's own corrector (or assessment-wide criteria) are included.

is_general.description: True: points may be given directly for the criterion (without comment). False: points for this criterion must be attached to a comment.

settings.description: Correction settings relevant for the provider
